comment: RUNTIME config for the headless Go agent service. The Go agent DOES NOT auto-register — this file must contain a pre-provisioned device_token. To deploy: 1) Register the device via the Tauri client or API to get a device_token, 2) Copy this file to C:\ProgramData\BetterDesk\agent\agent-config.json (Windows) or ~/.config/betterdesk/agent/agent-config.json (Linux/macOS), 3) Fill in device_token, device_id, device_name, 4) Start the service. For zero-touch auto-enrollment use the Tauri client (zoom-private.agent) instead.
